annotations.title: Ask a Person to Promote an Alert Rule

description: Ask a person to promote a test-mode rule to prod, with why it is ready and the evidence (runs, notifications it caught, false-positive checks). Agents create rules in test mode and cannot approve this themselves: a person approves on the rules page or with `securenow human approve-promotion`, which moves the rule to prod (its instant block, matching automations and the AI pipeline can then act on its alerts). One pending request per rule. Write action; requires confirmation.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

evidence.description: What shows it is ready: e.g. runs and their outcomes, notifications it raised on real attacks, how many false positives in how long.

id.description: Alert rule id (a custom rule in test mode).

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

name: securenow_alert_rule_request_promotion
title: Ask a Person to Promote an Alert Rule
